newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hawker in placement and acquisition.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hawker in placement and acquisition.

text.p: Industrial services group Hawker Richardson Ltd said on Tuesday it would raise A$18.4 million from the placement of 16 million shares at an issue price of A$1.15 per share.

Hawker said the placement would be offered to institutional investors and would be underwritten by stockbrokers ABS White & Co Ltd. It said the funds raised would be used for the A$24.3 million purchase of T.E.D. Engineering Investments Pty Ltd.
T.E.D. Engineering is a tool maker. The balance of the purchase would be funded by debt facilities with the National Australia Bank Ltd.
